parameters.prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body transparent PNG game sprite, native square at least 1024x1024. Image1 is original identity, Image2 primary paint/material style, Image3 fixed same-direction standing/proportions/equipment anchor. Match all identity and detail: 08 alchemy prodigy boy, huge round head, short stout child limbs, chestnut high topknot/teal gold cap/golden ribbons, orange-gold embroidered robe with teal lapels and panels, white baggy pants, teal/gold boots. HIS RIGHT hand holds bronze/teal yin-yang cauldron, HIS LEFT hand glass green potion bottle; back herbal basket with ivory scrolls, berries, green herbs and tassels. Keep equipment and head sizes, camera, perspective, character scale, no redesign. Bright polished hand-painted chibi volume. All head, boots and equipment fit in transparent margins, character height 84% square, ground contact baseline y=92%. True transparent alpha background, no colored outline, no ground/shadow/effect/text/grid. Single walking pose, not a sheet, no extra limbs. Both legs must be newly drawn for the specified biomechanical phase. Pelvis fixed over support zone, small natural stride with no running or floating. Direction W: EXACT LEFT SIDE PROFILE, nose points horizontally left, one eye visible, no front or rear three-quarter angle. Near visible arm is HIS LEFT hand with potion bottle; far HIS RIGHT hand with cauldron reaches forward screen-left behind/above potion arm with natural overlap, never swap their hands. Basket on his back at screen-right.  Walking phase 07 FAR RIGHT TERMINAL SWING. Image4 is later heel-contact frame09 for leg identity, Image5 preceding frame06. Keep the NEAR LEFT leg in foreground, broad and bright at screen-right; it supports x58%, ground y93%, heel just beginning to rise. NEAR LEFT thigh visibly covers part of FAR RIGHT thigh at crotch. The SMALLER shaded FAR RIGHT leg extends forward screen-left from behind this near thigh. Its knee straightens compared with preceding frame06, boot reaches x32%, heel bottom y90%, toe raised and pointing left; boot stays 3% above ground. Far boot about 20 percent smaller than near supporting boot. Do not let the far forward thigh cover the near supporting thigh. Keep the near leg in front spatially while far leg leads in walking direction. Fixed body scale/camera/identity, new single full-body walking pose with alpha background.
